verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only marketing claims (e.g., '3X training / 15X inference performance') and hardware/ops details (PSUs, NVLink bandwidth, memory), but no actual published TFLOPS/TOPS figures broken out by precision (FP8, FP16, INT8, etc.) or sparsity setting for the B200 GPU itself. Without such a spec table, an ML engineer cannot size training/inference from stated tensor throughput as the story requires.
